def: Add the area of the base and the triangle sides.
defEs: Sumar el área de la base y de los lados triangulares.
alt: Illustration of Surface Area of Pyramids: Add the area of the base and the triangle sides.

def: A solid with a flat bottom and triangles that meet on top.
defEs: Un sólido con fondo plano y lados triangulares que se juntan arriba.
alt: Illustration of Pyramid: A solid with a flat bottom and triangles that meet on top.

def: The height of a side triangle, measured along the tilted side.
defEs: La altura de un triángulo lateral, medida por su lado inclinado.
alt: Illustration of Slant height: The height of a side triangle, measured along the tilted side.

def: A side face of a solid, not the top or bottom.
defEs: Un lado de un sólido, no la parte de arriba ni la de abajo.
alt: Illustration of Lateral face: A side face of a solid, not the top or bottom.

def: The flat bottom of a pyramid.
defEs: La parte plana de abajo de una pirámide.
alt: Illustration of Base: The flat bottom of a pyramid.

def: The top point of a pyramid, where the sides meet.
defEs: El punto de arriba de una pirámide, donde se unen los lados.
alt: Illustration of Apex: The top point of a pyramid, where the sides meet.

def: The area of just the sides, not the bottom.
defEs: El área solo de los lados, sin el fondo.
alt: Illustration of Lateral area: The area of just the sides, not the bottom.

def: The area of all the flat sides added together.
defEs: El área de todos los lados planos sumados.
alt: Illustration of Surface area: The area of all the flat sides added together.
